name: The Horde Needs More Mithril Bars!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs More Mithril Bars!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yup, I be glad you're here, mon. You helped me before, and now I need your help again. We still lookin' ta bring in more mithril bars for the war effort; gonna build lots of armor and weapons and things to go squish them bugs at Ahn'Qiraj.
So if you be a true friend, you bring me back more stacks of mithril bars. I take all you got until we hit our quota. You have some for me now?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That be good work friend! Another twenty bars get us that much closer to the goal, and get us more war materiel. I see to it they get put away. And if you get another stack of mithril bars mon, you make sure to be bringin' them here to me.
